{
  "patch": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: /Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/core/_internal/text_utils.py\n@@\n import os\n from pathlib import Path\n+from typing import Callable\n \n from desloppify.core.runtime_state import current_runtime_context\n \n _DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get(\"DESLOPPIFY_ROOT\", Path.cwd())).resolve()\n \n-# Legacy module-level constant — kept for backwards compat, but prefer\n-# get_project_root() which respects RuntimeContext overrides.\n-PROJECT_ROOT = _DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT\n+class _DynamicPathProxy:\n+    \"\"\"Path-like proxy that resolves against current runtime context on access.\"\"\"\n+\n+    def __init__(self, resolver: Callable[[], Path], *, label: str) -> None:\n+        self._resolver = resolver\n+        self._label = label\n+\n+    def _value(self) -> Path:\n+        return self._resolver()\n+\n+    def __fspath__(self) -> str:\n+        return str(self._value())\n+\n+    def __str__(self) -> str:\n+        return str(self._value())\n+\n+    def __repr__(self) -> str:\n+        return f\"{self._label}({self._value()!s})\"\n+\n+    def __truediv__(self, other: object) -> Path:\n+        return self._value() / other\n+\n+    def __rtruediv__(self, other: object) -> Path:\n+        return Path(other) / self._value()\n+\n+    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> object:\n+        return getattr(self._value(), name)\n \n \n def get_project_root() -> Path:\n@@\n     override = current_runtime_context().project_root\n     if override is not None:\n         return override\n     return _DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT\n+\n+\n+# Backwards-compatible path object that now tracks runtime-root overrides.\n+PROJECT_ROOT = _DynamicPathProxy(get_project_root, label=\"PROJECT_ROOT\")\n*** End Patch\n"
}
